title: Uninstall
note: Project uninstall removes exact installer-owned checkout registration and folder trust only with exclusive ownership proof, including trust granted to the checkout's lanes, the Codex hook trust install minted for the checkout's hooks file and the copies mirrored onto its lanes. Trust Yoke did not record writing is neither changed nor reported; trust edited after Yoke wrote it stays and is reported without blocking completion. Shared or unproven registration is preserved. Machine uninstall shows a failed project step's named reasons. The removal commit records only files Git already tracked, so ignored local views stay out of history and strategy documents stay on disk untracked; the checkout mapping onboarding or install wrote counts as installer-owned. Partial cleanup keeps its manifest and .yoke/.gitignore, so the checkout stays clean and the same command retries to completion after the reported recovery. Self-host teardown preflights the checkouts registered to the retiring connections, uninstalls their relays and project layers before stopping Compose, and hands off to machine uninstall when no universe connection remains. A cleanup refusal keeps the server and connection available for retry. --keep-connection skips the machine-side cleanup. The bundle and database volume have separate removal flags. After a full machine uninstall, removing the bundle also removes the folders it leaves empty, up to and including the machine home; an operator file left in the bundle keeps the bundle and home.
